applicability: Whole pet food calorie calculation from AVERAGE proximate analyses
limitations: P,F,W,A,CF are same-state average g/100g as-fed; NFE=100-P-F-W-A-CF. Dietary fibre and human available carbohydrate are not CF/NFE. Predictions do not replace species/process applicability review. Guaranteed analysis cannot replace mean proximate composition; digestibility varies. No blanket proof of adequacy for homemade diets.
